versions.changelog:
- Updated example curl command in documentation to redact the bearer token for privacy.
- No functional or code changes; documentation only.

Initial release of curl-to-postman.

- Convert curl commands into Postman Collection v2.1 JSON for direct import.
- Supports common curl flags: request method, headers, body, and authentication.
- Handles SSL (-k/--insecure), redirects (-L/--location), and auth options.
- Automatically parses URL query parameters.
- Outputs ready-to-import, pretty-printed JSON for Postman.
